message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | The first book that introduced the world‑wide phenomenon of the Harry Potter series. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Continues Harry’s adventures at Hogwarts, featuring the mystery of the Chamber. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Focuses on the formation of Dumbledore’s Army and the Ministry’s denial of Voldemort’s return. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Delves into Voldemort’s past and the creation of Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the epic saga with the final battle at Hogwarts. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 (book) / 2016 (film) | A companion book to the film series, detailing magical creatures. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a political drama set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | The first book in the Cormoran Strike detective series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Troubled Blood** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2020 | Fifth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles represent the bulk of her most widely read and commercially successful works. The Harry Potter series, in particular, has sold over 500 million copies worldwide and has been translated into more than 80 languages.
